name: egg82
description: Methods and gates from one person's Claude Code setup: verification, honest docs, shell safety, delegation, config care, homelab ops.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Keep an agent-built codebase well designed: structural gates with held ledgers, tests proven able to fail, bug hunts proven by running them, API contracts.

plugins.name: vetting
plugins.description: Decide whether to adopt something: orient in an unfamiliar repo, vet a third-party project, judge a hyped AI tool, compare self-hosted apps.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Prose that doesn't read as model-written; READMEs, PR descriptions and wiki pages a stranger can read cold.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Web UIs that look alive without lying, rendered and looked at before they're called done; promo videos of a real site.

plugins.name: game-dev
plugins.description: Game design method with evidence labels, and choosing sound you can't hear.

plugins.name: shell-safety
plugins.description: Blocks shell commands whose result would lie silently, lints scripts as they're written, and catches detached work nobody is waiting on. Assumes the Bash tool runs bash.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Redacts secrets from Bash and Read output before they reach the model, using gitleaks plus extra rules.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Web searches that find the answer: query construction, reading a bad result set, and a gate that loads the method first.

plugins.name: delegation
plugins.description: Subagent fan-outs that stay affordable: briefs, a model named per agent, depth limits, a checkout shared safely with agents and other sessions.

plugins.name: config-care
plugins.description: Keep a Claude Code setup lean: a drift report at session start (plus an optional monthly sweep), always-on load pruning, and audits of skills that have grown long.

plugins.name: memory-discipline
plugins.description: Opinionated memory rules: refuses memory notes that are neither user/feedback nor carry a check, catches memory written from Bash, nudges lessons into the right home. Pair with stances/rules/memory-write-discipline.md.

plugins.name: config-transfer
plugins.description: Move Claude Code config between your own machines, or across a trust boundary as a scrubbed bundle the other side imports by function.

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: Survive compaction: the date and time on every prompt, a context-size nudge to write a handoff, a snapshot before compaction and read back after.

plugins.name: k8s-ops
plugins.description: Kubernetes runbooks from a homelab: triage, sizing, secrets, storage, ingress/TLS, Talos, Flux, CloudNativePG, cert renewal, Grafana dashboards.

plugins.name: linux-workstation
plugins.description: Immutable bootc/OSTree RHEL-family workstations: installing software, pinned-version scans, LUKS with TPM unlock, NVIDIA driver failures.
